plan.summary: Deliver a materially closer local estimate in three stories: safely recover evidenced missing historical descendants and exercise the shared collector; classify proven zero-cost refusals; make incomplete costs clear and document recovery. Quantitative target: recover $6.754276 for historical run 5, moving observed subtotal from $5.148750 to $11.903026 without changing later runs. No invoice perfection, multipliers or redesign.

user_story.want: preview and apply missing historical child usage and have the supported descendant cases collected correctly
user_story.benefit: my estimate includes evidenced work without charging resumed attempts twice
notes: Evidence AC-001: offline exact valuation/preview assertion; available session RUNTIME_EVIDENCE.json and RESEARCH_BRIEF.md retain authentic metadata/counters and source hashes. Codex 0.153.4, 2026-09-09 run 5, $10/$1/$50 per-million rates. Minimal source envelopes are reconstructed/synthetic. Missing prerequisite: executed fixture test plus provenance manifest; do not commit original private transcripts.

Evidence AC-002: isolated real-store apply/replay/interruption assertions over the same extracted historical windows and later root totals; retry schedules synthetic. Bounds: historical attribution and offline current-code behavior. Missing: executed transaction tests; actual live backfill remains a later explicit operator action.

Evidence AC-003: synthetic malformed/ambiguous/replaced/unsupported sources and selector tests plus safe-source review. Bounds: offline negative behavior only. Missing: executed tests; absent source stays unresolved.

Evidence AC-004: available authentic three-parallel-child extracts ground minimal envelopes; nested/delayed/unchanged-ancestor/limit topologies are synthetic. Bounds: Codex 0.153.4 historical shape and enumerated offline behavior. Missing: executed regressions. Authentic current full-hierarchy capture is unavailable and remains unverified, not discharged by fixtures. No nested paid capture is authorized.

acceptance_criteria.text: A read-only preview over the retained run-5 facts and an isolated historical store shows one root and three correctly parented/model-attributed children, $6.754276 additional observed usage and $11.903026 resulting subtotal at the recorded rates. Preview creates or changes no records, including schema/checkpoint/coverage records.

Explicit apply atomically yields the previewed attribution and subtotal using the original attempt price catalog, preserves existing measurements and attempt identity/outcome/timestamps, and is idempotent across repeat and interrupted/retried application. Runs 6, 7 and 8 remain $1.746696, $0.326984 and $0.558352. Concurrent state/source changes and overlap that cannot be proved exclusive refuse or remain unresolved without partial successful application; active attempts cannot be repaired.

Invalid selectors fail before mutation. Ambiguous, missing, replaced, malformed or unsupported evidence produces explicit unresolved/skipped reasons without guessed usage, model, ownership or false completeness. Recovery is scoped, bounded, preview by default and explicit apply only; safe source access and current-state/evidence revalidation are retained.

Executed shared-collector regression cases cover parallel and nested descendants, resumed deltas, inherited/foreign records, unchanged ancestors with active grandchildren, delayed discovery and scan limits. Each observable own-attempt response is charged once; historical/unrelated responses are excluded; unsupported/incomplete cases retain diagnostics. Include an Implement-labelled case on the shared path and fix demonstrated failures, without unbounded polling or claiming authentic present-day hierarchy certification.

tasks.description: Implement bounded provider-owned historical discovery and CLI preview using existing selectors, safe rollout access, observation identities and original attempt windows. Reuse source interpretation with live collection; parentage or filenames alone are insufficient.

Add a narrow finalized-attempt historical append operation and explicit apply. Reuse pure reconciliation and original catalogs; atomically revalidate/deduplicate the candidate batch. Keep live observation APIs rejecting finalized attempts; do source I/O outside transactions.
Fix shared collector failures demonstrated by the enumerated regressions, including ancestry visibility independent of measurable activity; retain bounded drains and diagnostics.

Write and execute deterministic collector/negative evidence tests and provenance-preserving sanitized fixtures. Distinguish authentic extracted counters from synthetic envelopes and topology scheduling.

Write and execute ordinary Go tests using migrated temporary SQLite stores and isolated source files for exact preview/apply totals, original catalogs, replay/interruption/concurrent changes, no-mutation preview, active-attempt rejection and unaffected later runs. No integration tags or live database.
